prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
# Semantic Texture Mark Overlay

A stylized semantic texture overlay marker. Simplified app-icon geometry.

A compact cluster of five small abstract glyphs: a three-line wave, a zigzag fracture, a five-dot grain mark, a two-prong fork, and two short slash ticks. Each glyph is a flat saturated palette shape with sharp clean edges and clear spacing. Reads as semantic texture at map scale.

formatted_prompt.scene: Flat filled-vector app icon, compact cluster of five abstract texture glyphs arranged on a plain off-white canvas, each glyph a bold saturated primary shape with crisp sharp edges and clear spacing between marks.

subjects.description: three-line horizontal wave glyph beside a sharp angular zigzag fracture glyph, tall crisp flat shapes with deliberate spacing
five-dot quincunx grain mark beside a two-prong fork glyph, bold flat fills, sharp geometric silhouettes, high readability at 16px
two short diagonal slash ticks, compact flat strokes, strong angular edges, clear separation from surrounding glyphs, strictly in color #FF6600 vivid orange
